note: A translucent neon tube writes a lowercase cursive word from 0.4 s to about 4 s with colours flowing along the stroke, inside a glowing rainbow frame, then holds. The full loop is 10 s (the erase starts at 8.3 s), so 8 s shows write + hold. No mouse script: the pointer only brightens the frame glow near it, barely visible.
varies: the stroke and the colour flow follow the real clock from when the WebGL loop starts, so the pen position and colours differ slightly per load
